intent: A kill feed in the top-left corner shows short coloured messages like 'Alice ate Bot' whenever a player or bot swallows another; each line fades out after a few seconds, so players see who is hunting whom.
accept: When one player/bot swallows another, a line naming killer and victim appears in a corner of the screen
Each line is coloured by the killer's colour (own = light blue, bots = red) and fades out within a few seconds
At most a handful of lines show at once, newest on top, and they do not overlap the minimap
In the preview after clip at least one kill-feed message is visible
